title: Fix Flow Dag Manifest Staleness Bug In Graph Manifest Generator
description:
Investigate and fix the pre-existing (not caused by the crate-consolidation restructure) build blocker documented in the master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md: infinite-board-port-directed-dag's lib.rs imports `mathematical_graph_manifest::flow_dag::flow_dag_manifest`, but the graph-manifest generator's registry has no `flow_dag` module, blocking cargo check/test for semio-s-plugin-space and anything depending on the dag port.

Root-cause it: read the consumer (validate_dag_fixture_node_kinds), the generator (script.ts's findManifestFiles discovery + lib.rs), and git history/blame to find what happened to the flow-dag manifest source file. Determine whether this is a rename that needs a repoint, a genuine removal needing a different data source, or dead validation that should be removed — per CLAUDE.md, do not fabricate a fix; if genuinely unconfident, stop and report.
summary:
Root-caused and fixed the flow_dag_manifest() build blocker. The graph-manifest generator's findManifestFiles() (🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/🕸️graph/🛂️manifest/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts) required every `*.manifest.json` source file to sit under a directory literally named `manifest`/`🛂️manifest`. A same-day taxonomy migration (commit 2eabb14886, Aug 5) moved the flow plugin's manifest fixture from `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🛂️manifest/🛂️manifest.jsondag.manifest.json` (id `flow-dag`, discoverable) to the new `🗿️artifacts/<component>/🛂️manifest.json` per-artifact taxonomy layout — `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🗿️artifacts/🌊️flow/🛂️manifest.json` — which has no `manifest`-named parent directory and a bare filename that doesn't end in `.manifest.json` (no leading dot before `manifest.json`). The generator's discovery walk silently stopped finding it (and, it turned out, three sibling files that had migrated the same way: writer-languages, note-blocks, wires), so `flow_dag` never appeared in the generated registry even though nothing about the manifest's content or the consumer's import (`mathematical_graph_manifest::flow_dag::flow_dag_manifest`, unchanged since introduction) had changed.

Fix (framework-only, no plugin taxonomy touched): changed the filename predicate in findManifestFiles() to match any file whose name starts with the `🛂️manifest.json` tag prefix (bare, or with a `<descriptor>.manifest.json` suffix to disambiguate multiple manifests in one directory) and ends in `.json`, dropping the now-incorrect directory-name requirement entirely. This is the actual invariant already followed by every manifest source file in the repo.

Verified: `rm -rf 🤖️generated && cargo check -p semio-framework-os-kernel-math-graph-manifest` regenerates registry.rs with all 13 families including flow_dag, wires, note_blocks, writer_languages. `cargo check -p semio-framework-os-kernel-infinite-board-port-directed-dag` and `-p semio-s-plugin-space` both compile clean (only pre-existing unrelated lint warnings). `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools cargo test -p semio-framework-os-kernel-infinite-board-port-directed-dag --lib` — 117/117 pass, including fixture-driven tests that exercise validate_dag_fixture_node_kinds via flow_dag_manifest(). Full `cargo check --workspace` shows 89 "mismatched closing delimiter" errors confined to 5 unrelated plugin crates (fem-2d-ui, fem-3d-ui, trinity-rewrite-ui, remodel-ui, trinity-jack-ui) from other in-flight migration work — nothing related to graph-manifest, the dag port, or the space plugin; log saved to verification-workspace-check.txt in this ticket folder.
